plugins.name: normativa
plugins.description: Normativa — Maldonado UY zoning toolkit (TONE / Digesto Departamental, Volumen V). Dispatcher /normativa routes to sub-skills: /normativa-analyze (envelope analysis) + /normativa-informe (printable A4 HTML report) + /normativa-massing (interactive 3D massing configurator). Includes shared rules (envelope contract, disclaimer, units, terminology), a marker-driven disclaimer hook, and a structural lint.

plugins.name: norma
plugins.description: DEPRECATED alias of `normativa`. The plugin was renamed 2026-08-27 so the command matches the repo and the skills (/normativa, /normativa-analyze, /normativa-informe, /normativa-massing). This entry exists so `/plugin update` keeps resolving for anyone installed as norma@normativa; install new as normativa@normativa.
